page_title: BOL 0-3 ACM | Bologna v AC Milan 03/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out.
83' Davide Bartesaghi is being substituted because of an injury. Massimiliano Allegri sends Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) on the pitch.
82' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Federico Ravaglia.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) for Juan Miranda.
78' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jonathan Rowe is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
75' Corner kicks – 5:0.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luka Modric walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ardon Jashari (AC Milan).
72' Substitution. Christopher Nkunku leaves the pitch and is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
71' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek walks off the pitch and Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) comes on as a substitute.
67' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Zachary Athekame and he is replaced by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan).
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) is replacing Remo Freuler.
64' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
61' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Remo Freuler (Bologna) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
54' Here is a change. Santiago Castro is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) comes onto the pitch for Riccardo Orsolini.
51' Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
48' 0 - 3 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:3.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' The AC Milan players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Federico Ravaglia no chance!
38' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
38' Referee Gianluca Manganiello is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to AC Milan!
37' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to AC Milan, he's going to review using VAR.
37' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle after Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. PENALTY to AC Milan! Great chance to score.
31' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call.
25' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.

20' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Adrien Rabiot, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan), who beats Federico Ravaglia with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 0:1.
18' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
16' Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan).
12' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) obviously dived.
11' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Jens Odgaard (Bologna), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
8' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) dribbles into the box, but Federico Ravaglia is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
7' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
4' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
4' The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Bologna take a short corner kick.
3' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Bologna will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will referee today's match.
